text: Absolutely, extending evening hours would be highly beneficial! With a certified night staffing plan in place, we can ensure both staff and security cover during these extended hours. Additionally, implementing a midnight reading festival will not only attract new patrons but also foster a vibrant community atmosphere. Furthermore, the significant cost savings from a recent lighting retrofit make it financially viable to operate at reduced costs, making this an attractive option. Lastly, the success of a nearby branch operating similarly suggests that our strategy will likely yield positive results. By expanding access to our services after dark, we can better serve those who need it most while enhancing overall library usage and satisfaction.
